summary: Routine ACC without the owner bottleneck (Ed 2026-11-18). Adds communities.acc_delegation (the written instrument under which Bedrock decides ACC applications) and sets it for Waterview Estates only (Guidelines 2016 §1.4.4.1-1.4.4.2). Replaces the ACC decision-authority trigger function: denials no longer need Ed's review; only Ed's two exceptions (approval_gate 'required': concrete additions, driveway modifications) do; Annie may approve or deny a routine case under the written delegation on a recorded review. All committee/Board and authority checks unchanged. No acc_decisions rows change.

preflight.name: Waterview Estates present, no delegation yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND name = 'Waterview Estates'

preflight.name: Waterview Guidelines (2016) on file for Waterview
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM library_documents WHERE id = '6eeb8060-9b0a-4e88-b714-45f775a0442a' AND community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'

expected_changes: communities gains acc_delegation (jsonb, nullable); Waterview Estates gets its delegation; every other community stays NULL.

acc_decisions_decision_authority_guard() replaced (same trigger): denials without Ed allowed; Ed exceptions (approval_gate required) need Ed; Annie routine approvals and denials under the written delegation allowed.
No rows added or deleted; no acc_decisions row changes.

verify.name: only Waterview has a delegation
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE acc_delegation IS NOT NULL

verify.name: Waterview delegation cites the Guidelines on file
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' AND acc_delegation->>'library_document_id' = '6eeb8060-9b0a-4e88-b714-45f775a0442a'

verify.name: trigger function allows routine agent decisions
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'acc_decisions_decision_authority_guard' AND prosrc LIKE '%routine_delegated%' AND prosrc NOT LIKE '%a denial needs Ed%'
